requirements.text: Keep reservation actions keyboard accessible with visible focus.
requirements.quote: All core reservation actions must work with a keyboard and visible focus.
requirements.speaker: Jun

requirements.text: Let each member save and clear one personal category-only catalogue preset between visits.
requirements.quote: Let each member save one personal catalogue filter preset between visits.
requirements.speaker: Owen
requirements.note: Subsequent clarification limits the preset to category, excludes dates and retains alphabetical ordering.

requirements.text: Clarify what making the reservation form faster means.
requirements.quote: The reservation form should be faster.
requirements.speaker: Jun
requirements.note: No bottleneck, metric or target is agreed; do not invent a two-second target.

requirements.text: Show a text label alongside status colors.
requirements.quote: Keep a text label next to any status color.
requirements.speaker: Jun

expected_stories.title: Remember a personal catalogue category
expected_stories.i_want: save and clear one category filter preset between visits
expected_stories.so_that: I can return to my usual equipment category
acceptance_criteria: Given a saved category preset, when the member returns to the catalogue, then the category is restored while dates are not restored and alphabetical ordering remains.
Given a saved preset, when the member clears it and returns again, then no category preset is applied.

questions: Which observed reservation task is slow, and what measurable target would improve it?
